map.根据温度、风速、湿度等综合判断大棚卷放膜时机: Judge greenhouse film roll-up/down timing from temperature, wind, and humidity
map.📖 查看「大棚卷膜时间建议器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Greenhouse Film-Rolling Time Advisor Guide"
map.分级判定：棚温 > 作物耐温上限 → 立即卷膜；棚温 > 目标温 + 3℃ →: Graded: house temp > crop upper limit -> roll up now; house temp > target + 3C -> suggest roll up; humidity > 85% -> small roll to dehumidify; else keep
map.按时段（早/午/晚）与温度、湿度、风速分档给出卷放膜建议，非单一公式。核心阈值：: Advice is given by time slot (morning/noon/evening) and temperature, humidity, wind tiers, not a single formula. Core thresholds: above crop upper temp is emergency ventilation; above target +3C is suggested ventilation; humidity over 85% needs dehumidifying; high wind suggests top small vents slowly to avoid film damage. Results give action (roll up/down/keep), urgency, and reason for greenhouse climate control.

map.按棚内温度/湿度目标与室外气象建议卷膜（通风）时段。: Suggest film roll-up (ventilation) by indoor temp/humidity targets and outdoor weather.
map.冬季午间高温短时卷膜排湿，夏季早晚大通风降温。: Short high-temp roll-up at noon in winter to dehumidify; large ventilation morning and evening in summer to cool.
map.用于缓解棚内高湿引发的病害。: Used to ease humidity-driven diseases in the house.
map.棚内湿度 95%、温度 25℃（超高湿），室外 8℃、微风。建议 10:00~1: House humidity 95%, temp 25C (very high); outside 8C, light breeze. Suggest roll up 1/3 from 10:00-11:30 for 30 min to dehumidify, drop humidity below 80% then close to retain heat, avoiding all-day high humidity that triggers disease.
map.为什么冬季也要卷膜？: Why roll film even in winter?
map.冬季密闭棚内夜间呼吸+蒸腾使湿度极高，是灰霉、霜霉爆发温床。午间短时通风排湿比一: Sealed winter houses have very high humidity from night respiration and transpiration, a hotbed for gray and downy mildew. Short midday ventilation to dehumidify matters more than only keeping warm; the key is "dehumidify without over-cooling".
map.大风天能卷膜吗？: Can you roll film on windy days?
map.应减小开度或择时。强风卷膜易损伤棚膜、灌冷风闪苗。关注风速预警，5 级以上建议只: Reduce opening or pick timing. Strong wind easily damages film and pours cold air that shocks seedlings. Watch wind warnings; above level 5 only slightly open the top vent.
